vision.name: Saiyan Oppressive Mastery
vision.text:
(You cannot win by MPPV.)
[Continuous]: Your first Styled attack each combat gains "Your opponent skips their next action this combat." Whenever your opponent skips an action, gain 2 stages or raise your anger 1 level.
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Draw a card. Discard a card from your hand.
POWER: If the top card of your discard pile is Styled, your opponent loses 2 stages and Rejuvenate the bottom card of your discard pile.
